input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

doc_friction.issue: Says to start promptctl.py measure in run_in_background, and friction_rank is the natural next call; both fetch into the same shallow clone, so friction_rank's fetch failed silently on shallow.lock and every cluster showed touched-since unknown (26 hidden vs 48 on a clean rerun). friction_rank now waits for the lock; prompt could say to run them one after the other.
measure's 14-day fetch also swallows a failed fetch (except: pass, returncode unchecked); same fix as friction_rank.deepen, but under prompts/ so it needs the owner's approval.

At session start, refs/remotes/origin/main pointed at a 2026-11-13 commit (#15695) while HEAD and the remote were at #17016; git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main was false until measure's fetch force-updated the ref. Tools that read origin/main before any fetch see stale main.

notes: Critique mode (backlog had owner rows only). Lens: today's doc_friction plus friction_rank --live --ungated --days 3. Fixed platform/ci/friction_rank.py deepen(): waits up to 240 s for .git/shallow.lock, retries once on a lock failure, prints the reason on any failure. test_friction_rank.py 24 passed. Also .gitignore MUJOCO_LOG.TXT. Checked flagship_field --replace silent no-op report: already fixed by #16811. main_health: 260/260 pass. promptctl validate ok. run_workflow_locally --for-changes: 7/7 selected workflows passed (agent-cross-review and deploy jobs not runnable locally). No backlog ids touched (backlog is under the gated prompts/ path).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: diagnose a silent git lock race, patch and unit-test a retry, write a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
